| Evidence quality | **Low** |
| Gate criteria ("market opportunity passes agreed threshold") | **CONDITIONAL PASS.** No threshold had actually been agreed anywhere upstream; I define one in §6 and adopt it as DECISION D-007. Against it: **"Bengali book translation" as scoped in IB-001 FAILS. "Verified low-verifiability-language edition production, Bengali-first" PASSES.** Formal decision in §7. |
